title: Definition of Diffraction
description: Essential Criteria: Clearly distinguish between Fraunhofer and Fresnel diffraction based on experimental arrangements.

title: Experimental Setup
description: Essential Criteria: Provide a correct schematic of the experimental arrangement for observing Fraunhofer diffraction.

title: Single-Slit Pattern
description: Important Criteria: Describe the intensity distribution and key features of the single-slit diffraction pattern.

title: Double-Slit Pattern
description: Important Criteria: Explain the intensity distribution and key features of the double-slit diffraction pattern, including the effect of single-slit diffraction.

title: Three-Slit Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly derive the intensity pattern for three equally spaced slits in Young's experiment.

title: Missing Orders Explanation
description: Optional Criteria: Discuss the concept of missing orders in the context of the double-slit and single-slit patterns.

title: Units and Factors
description: Optional Criteria: Ensure that all equations and calculations include appropriate units and factors.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Identify and avoid common mistakes such as sign errors or incorrect application of diffraction conditions.
